verses.text: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik t'a schonhab': Ex israel, ¿tom tze na'a to a in ix ex in pechb'at icha junok winh spechanb'at yetb'eyum? Tato icha chi', ¿b'ajtil ay yumal puklajb'ail ix in b'o chi' heyet'ok? ¿Tom a in ix ex in chonhb'at chekab'ok? Tato icha chi' ¿mach b'aj ay in b'ok, yuj chi' ix ex in chonhb'ati? Ha ex tik, ix ex ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok nacional yuj he mul, yuj he chukal.

¿Tas yuj ayik ix in jawi, malaj mach ix wila''? ¿Tas yuj ayik ix ex wawtani malaj mach ix in tak'wani? ¿Tom max techaj wuj ex in kolan he naani? ¿Tom max yal ex wak'anel t'a libre? Naek wal to k'okb'il junok b'elanh lolonel swala', stupem ha' mar, haxo b'aj sb'ey ha' niwak ha', takinh tz'ajkani, haxo nok' chay, xcham nok' yuj takinhtial, sk'ab'at nok' yuj manh ha'il.
Ha in swak' k'ik'b'okel satcha'anh, icha heb' skus yuj schamnak, xchi Jehová.

Ha jun schekab' Jehová chi' tz'alan icha tik: Ha Jehová Wajalil, a ix ak'an jelanb'ok in loloni yik wach' swak' stek'anil heb' k'unb'elal yaji. Junjun q'uinhib'alil syak'an in nib'ej yik swab' tas syak' in k'ayb'ej.
Ha Jehová Wajalil ix ak'an sjelanil in pensar, ix in k'anab'ajejnhej, manh pitok ix wutej in b'a.
Ix wak' yich in patik smak' heb' ajk'ool. Malaj tas swal t'a heb' stzukanel xil in ti'. Maj in k'ub'ejel in sat t'a heb' tzin b'uchani yet' heb' stzub'an in sat.
Ha Jehová Yajal, a skolwaj wet'ok, yuj chi' maj chab'ax in k'ol yuj tas tzin yutej heb' chi'. Tek'an ix wutej in b'a wak'an techajok, yujto wojtak to manh ol el in q'uixwelal.

Ha jun tzin kolani, ayek' t'a in tz'ey. Tato ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh, tzin b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh winh tzin ch'olb'itani. Ha junok ay chukal syal t'a in patik, kotokab' t'a in tz'ey tik, syalani.
Ha Jehová Yajal, ha' skolwaj wet'ok. ¿Mach ol yal yak'anoch junok tas t'a wib'anh? Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol lajwokel heb' icha junok pichul ijtakxo, xchi jun schekab' Jehová chi'.

Ha ex ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol he sat, tzeyab'anpax tas syal schekab': Tato tzex b'ey t'a k'ik' k'inal, tato malaj tas tz'ak'an sakq'uinal t'ayex, ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'ool, tzex b'eynhej yet'ok.
Ha exxo tzeyak'och sk'ak'al juntzanh te' yik syak' yok t'ayex, hanheja' t'a yok chi' tzex b'eyi. Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot jun yaelal t'a eyib'anh, toxonhej ol ex emkan jichan t'a skal eyaelal chi'.
